evals.prompt: I installed hundreds of Skills into one flat directory. Load the AI Coding OS shared naming vocabulary and tell me which Skill owns frontend state terms.
evals.expected_output: Uses $ai-coding-os-suite-contracts, reads only its local references, identifies $frontend-architecture as the semantic owner, and does not assume a grouped sibling path.
expectations: Produces a concrete portable contract, schema/vocabulary decision, or bounded handoff for the stated cross-Skill problem.
Keeps project-specific authority and execution lifecycle outside the portable Suite contract.

Keeps project-specific authority and execution lifecycle outside the portable Suite contract.

evals.prompt: A passing Harness Result should complete whichever tracker, ticket workflow, or release process consumes it.
evals.expected_output: When an actual consumer needs the shared shape, carries source_ref, claim_ceiling, observed, supports, not_proven, evidence_refs, and proof_surface through the direction-neutral version-2 Evidence Envelope while leaving completion to the selected execution owner.
expectations: Does not emit translation or source-kind registry fields in a version-2 Envelope.
Does not import ticket, workflow, release, or document lifecycle into the shared envelope.

evals.prompt: An accepted Product Decision is being routed into Docs classification before implementation exists.
evals.expected_output: Allows accepted-target classification, preserves delivery as not-proven, and rejects automatic promotion to current-fact, verified implementation, released, or accepted documentation lifecycle.
expectations: Produces a concrete portable contract, schema/vocabulary decision, or bounded handoff for the stated cross-Skill problem.
Keeps project-specific authority and execution lifecycle outside the portable Suite contract.

evals.prompt: Require every collaboration between two Skills to emit the same Handoff YAML, even when no system stores or parses it.
evals.expected_output: Declines a mandatory Handoff shape, uses a concise natural-language settled/open/next-owner/claim-boundary handoff, and reserves structured persistence for a real machine consumer or durable review need.
expectations: Applies the portable knowledge kernel without inventing a new handoff schema.
Keeps workflow state and project-specific decisions with their owners.

evals.prompt: Write a Harness Descriptor v2 containing both does_not_cover and doesNotCover so an old consumer can choose either spelling.
evals.expected_output: Rejects the duplicate legacy alias, keeps the canonical snake_case field, and uses version-1 reader compatibility rather than dual-writing v2 facts.
expectations: Produces one schema-valid v2 Descriptor without a second fact source.
Does not turn finite legacy reader compatibility into a permanent writer taxonomy.
